summary: Adds an email search function with pagination. It has a missing admin check, SQL built from user input, an off-by-one in pagination, and an unguarded index into an empty result. Do not merge until the security items are fixed.

requirements.evidence: app/users.py:19 uses LOWER(email) LIKE, but the value is injected into SQL

requirements.text: 20 results per page, page numbers start at 1
requirements.evidence: app/users.py:16 uses page * PAGE_SIZE, so page 1 skips the first 20 rows

requirements.text: Empty search term rejected with 'term required'
requirements.evidence: app/users.py:14 only checks for None, so '' passes

requirements.text: Never build SQL from user input

new_findings.title: SQL injection via search term
new_findings.body: term is interpolated into the query string. Use a parameter placeholder, e.g. conn.execute(sql, (f"%{term.lower()}%", PAGE_SIZE, offset)).

new_findings.title: No admin check on search_users
new_findings.body: The ticket requires admin-only search. Accept the requester's role and raise PermissionError when it is not 'admin'.

new_findings.title: Off-by-one pagination offset
new_findings.body: offset = page * PAGE_SIZE makes page 1 skip the first 20 results. Use (page - 1) * PAGE_SIZE.

new_findings.title: Empty term is not rejected
new_findings.body: Use `if not term:` so that an empty string raises 'term required'.

new_findings.title: IndexError when there are no matches
new_findings.body: rows[0] fails on an empty result. Return None when rows is empty.
